plan: An uncontrollable vampire jungler: she charges the nearest enemy and heals by biting them.
aSurveiller: Her W (Blood Frenzy). She loses control and chases the nearest target while hitting very fast: back off or put a tankier ally between you.
contrer: During her frenzy (W) she attacks the nearest enemy: let a tank stand in front of you.
Buy a Grievous Wounds item: she heals a huge amount in fights.
Slow her or run: during her frenzy she can't choose her target and puts herself in danger.
forces: Huge healing and damage in duels.
Her R crosses the map to engage.
Stronger when she's low on health.
faiblesses: Little control over her target during her frenzy.
Barely regenerates health out of combat.
Weak to Grievous Wounds items and slows.

sorts.P: Her hits cause bleeding and heal her; stronger when she's low on health.
sorts.Q: Leaps onto a target, stuns it and reduces its armour.
sorts.W: Frenzy: attacks the nearest enemy very fast; recasting heals her.
sorts.E: Charged scream that damages and slows; she takes less damage while charging.
sorts.R: Throws her pin across the map and flies to the first champion hit.

momentFort: Very strong early in the jungle, and dangerous from level 6.
